action.command: cd /d "%WORKSPACE_DIR%" && uvx detect-secrets scan "%FILE_PATH%" 2>&1 | python -c "import sys,json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); results=data.get('results',{}); hits=[f for f in results if results[f]]; print('[SECRET SCAN FAIL] Potential secrets in: '+str(hits)) if hits else print('[SECRET SCAN PASS] '+sys.argv[0])" -- "%FILE_PATH%" 2>&1 || echo "[SECRET SCAN] detect-secrets not available — run: uvx detect-secrets scan ."
